long_biography.plain_text:
Costantini left Rome for Houston with his family at thirteen. Once naturalised, he enlisted in the Navy for four years, crossing the Pacific twice and travelling to the Arctic. The experience gave him a lasting attachment to maritime life. His father, engineer and developer Mario Costantini, meanwhile established the family in Houston’s property sector after working in Italy and Brazil.

In civilian life, Costantini moved into facilities work. He became associated with Syntecos as president and with Soji Services as owner, overseeing commercial cleaning, restaurant-kitchen maintenance and general building support. Outside business, he and his wife backed opera, youth sport and community fundraising in Steamboat Springs.
